title: Southern Tofu Curry
description: A southern twist on the classic curry dish, featuring crispy tofu and earthy flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the curry powder and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the curry powder mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the tofu is coated in the curry sauce.
Serve the tofu and curry sauce over southern-style coleslaw and crusty bread.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
